tests.name: long_double_locale_multibyte_dump
tests.intent: Verify that dumping a long double under a locale with a multibyte decimal point replaces it correctly without corruption.

tests.name: long_double_integer_part_only
tests.intent: Verify dumping a long double with no fractional part under a multibyte locale.

tests.name: long_double_negative_fraction
tests.intent: Verify dumping a negative fractional long double under a multibyte locale.

tests.name: long_double_scientific_notation
tests.intent: Verify dumping a long double in scientific notation under a multibyte locale.

tests.name: standard_double_locale_independent
tests.intent: Verify that standard double is unaffected by the locale decimal point changes and uses to_chars.

tests.name: standard_float_locale_independent
tests.intent: Verify that standard float json type behaves correctly under a multibyte locale.

tests.name: long_double_large_number
tests.intent: Verify dumping a large long double value under a multibyte locale.

tests.name: c_locale_long_double_dump
tests.intent: Verify dumping a long double under the standard C locale works as expected.

tests.name: de_locale_single_byte_comma
tests.intent: Verify dumping a long double under a single-byte comma decimal point locale (e.g., de_DE).

tests.name: ordered_json_long_double
tests.intent: Verify ordered_json with long double under a multibyte decimal locale.

tests.name: long_double_zero_value
tests.intent: Verify dumping zero as long double under a multibyte locale.

tests.name: long_double_tiny_fraction
tests.intent: Verify dumping a tiny long double fraction under a multibyte locale.

tests.name: long_double_array_dump
tests.intent: Verify dumping an array of long doubles under a multibyte locale.

tests.name: long_double_object_dump
tests.intent: Verify dumping an object containing long doubles under a multibyte locale.

tests.name: json_pointer_with_long_double
tests.intent: Verify json_pointer lookup and container operations on long double json objects.

tests.name: json_patch_long_double
tests.intent: Verify applying a patch operation on a long double json document under a multibyte locale.

tests.name: json_patch_long_double_fixed
tests.intent: Verify applying a patch operation on a long double json document under a multibyte locale.
